import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import kotlin.math.min

fun modPow(base: Long, exp: Long, mod: Long): Long {
    var b = base % mod
    var e = exp
    var res = 1L
    while (e > 0) {
        if ((e and 1L) == 1L) res = (res * b) % mod
        b = (b * b) % mod
        e = e shr 1
    }
    return res
}

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val parts = br.readLine().trim().split(" ")
    val a = parts[0].toLong()
    val b = parts[1].toLong()
    val p = parts[2].toLong()
    val x = parts[3].toLong()

    val phi = p - 1
    val invA = modPow(a, phi - 1, p) // a^{-1} mod p

    var ans = 0L
    var cur = 1L

    for (k in 0 until phi) {
        val rhs = (b * modPow(cur, phi - 2, p)) % p
        val n0 = (rhs * invA) % p
        if (n0 == 0L) {
            cur = (cur * a) % p
            continue
        }
        val first = n0 + k * p
        if (first > x) {
            cur = (cur * a) % p
            continue
        }
        val count = (x - first) / (phi * p) + 1
        ans += count
        cur = (cur * a) % p
    }

    println(ans)
}

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import kotlin.math.min

fun modPow(base: Long, exp: Long, mod: Long): Long {
    var b = base % mod
    var e = exp
    var res = 1L
    while (e > 0) {
        if ((e and 1L) != 0L) res = (res * b) % mod
        b = (b * b) % mod
        e = e shr 1
    }
    return res
}

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val parts = br.readLine().trim().split(" ")
    val a = parts[0].toLong()
    val b = parts[1].toLong()
    val p = parts[2].toLong()
    val x = parts[3].toLong()

    val phi = p - 1
    val maxT = min(phi, x)
    val invA = modPow(a, phi - 1, p) // a^{-1} mod p

    var ans = 0L
    var cur = 1L
    var t = 1L
    while (t <= maxT) {
        cur = (cur * invA) % p
        val rhs = (b * cur) % p
        var n = t
        while (n <= x) {
            if (n % p == rhs) ans++
            if (n > x - phi) break
            n += phi
        }
        t++
    }
    println(ans)
}

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import kotlin.math.min

fun modPow(base: Long, exp: Long, mod: Long): Long {
    var b = base % mod
    var e = exp
    var res = 1L
    while (e > 0) {
        if ((e and 1L) != 0L) res = (res * b) % mod
        b = (b * b) % mod
        e = e shr 1
    }
    return res
}

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val parts = br.readLine().trim().split(" ")
    val a = parts[0].toLong()
    val b = parts[1].toLong()
    val p = parts[2].toLong()
    val x = parts[3].toLong()

    val phi = p - 1
    val maxK = (x - 1) / phi

    val invA = modPow(a, phi - 1, p) // a^{-1} mod p

    // Precompute invA^t for t = 0..phi-1
    val invPow = LongArray(phi.toInt())
    invPow[0] = 1L
    for (t in 1 until phi.toInt()) {
        invPow[t] = (invPow[t - 1] * invA) % p
    }

    // Precompute a^t for t = 0..phi-1
    val aPow = LongArray(phi.toInt())
    aPow[0] = 1L
    for (t in 1 until phi.toInt()) {
        aPow[t] = (aPow[t - 1] * a) % p
    }

    var ans = 0L

    for (t in 0 until phi.toInt()) {
        val c = (b * invPow[t]) % p
        val kStart = t.toLong()
        val kStep = phi
        if (kStart > maxK) continue
        val maxIdx = ((maxK - kStart) / kStep).toInt()
        var kIdx = 0
        var k = kStart
        while (kIdx <= maxIdx) {
            val n = k * phi + t
            val lhs = (n % p * aPow[t]) % p
            if (lhs == b) ans++
            kIdx++
            k += kStep
        }
    }

    println(ans)
}
